decisions.reason: The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already captures the simple, easy-to-navigate layout direction; the source MODIFY adds location-listing behavior only to the hub requirement.
Listing locations in the master hub does not change the reusable template structure used to integrate new franchise location sites.
The navigation change does not alter separate booking, revenue, sales, or management control for each location; the same message's control requirement is already represented.
The master site's location-listing layout does not change the Wix Bookings platform or location-site booking behavior.
The location-navigation layout does not change the Smash Room brand name or its application across the master and location sites.
